**MultiTool Pro – The Ultimate All-in-One Toolkit (80+ Free Tools, AI Hub, Browser, Converter, Games & More)**  

🚀 **One app. Everything.** No more switching. MultiTool Pro delivers **80+ professional tools** absolutely **FREE** – no paywalls, no subscriptions.  

⭐ **Core Utilities (50+)**  
Advanced calculator (sin, cos, tan, log), password generator (custom length, chars), word counter + reading time, case converter (UPPER, lower, Title, Sentence, aLtErNaTiNg, iNVERSE), color picker (HEX/RGB/HSL + history), unit converter (length, mass, volume, area, temp, speed, time, digital), stopwatch with laps, QR code generator (colors, size, error correction), BMI (metric/imperial), random number generator (multiple, duplicates, sort, decimals), countdown timer (sound alert), date difference, Base64 + file support, URL encode/decode, JSON formatter/minify/validate, Lorem Ipsum generator, live currency converter (160+ currencies), percentage calculator (3 types), age calculator, binary/hex/octal/decimal converter, Roman numeral converter, tip calculator (split bill), world clock (ALL time zones – searchable, 12/24h), dice roller (d4 to d20), coin flip (streak counter), fresh jokes (categories + safe mode), IP geolocation (map link).  

🤖 **AI Hub**  
Paraphraser, grammar & spell check, summarizer, sentiment analysis, keyword extractor, readability checker, and **AI Text Enhancer** (6 modes: grammar fix, professional, friendly, shorten, expand, simplify).  

🌐 **Massive Online Resources (100+)**  
- **Media/Video** – Dailymotion, Vimeo, Twitch, Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, Crunchyroll, Tubi, Pluto TV.  
- **Popular Sites** – Reddit, Pinterest, Telegram Web, WhatsApp Web, SoundCloud, DeviantArt, Goodreads, Stack Overflow.  
- **TV / RADIO** – RedBull TV, Samsung TV Plus, TuneIn, iHeartRadio, Radio Garden, BBC Sounds.  
- **Browsers** – Surf inside app (fullscreen, mobile/desktop toggle, internal tab).  
- **Convert & Edit** – PDF tools (PDFescape, Sejda), image editors (Fotor), document editors (Google Docs), file converters (Zamzar), audio/video (VEED).  
- **AI Translation** – Google Translate, Lernix AI, Reverso, Microsoft, Yandex, Baidu, Papago.  
- **Games** – Steam, Epic Games, Roblox, Minecraft, Poki, CrazyGames, Newgrounds.  
- **Money & Investments** – Insurance (Geico), loans (LendingTree), trading (Robinhood, Coinbase), budgeting (Mint).  
- **RDP, VPN & Preview** – Neverinstall, CroxyProxy, ProtonVPN, BrowserStack, Screenfly.
